_comment: English for the Thai questions of the approved project report's FAQ (19_faq.md). Each English question is tied to its Thai question by exact text and can only bring back THAT question's approved answer -- no answer text lives here. A Thai question edited in the report no longer matches and its English drops out (logged). Robot 20 Oct: English questions could not match the Thai FAQ by words (app/project_report.py).
